hero.title: A scientific coach for your season
hero.lead: First, the analysis of your sessions in the dashboard. To go further, a follow-up of your data or a coach for the whole season, from a first marathon to the podium.
hero.alt: Trail runner on a mountain path, snowy peaks behind

analysis.title: What a session tells you
analysis.lead: Connect Strava: your sessions show up in the Activities tab of the dashboard. The in-depth analysis of a session, on demand, shows the detail.

type.title: Session type
type.text: detected automatically, for example 4 × 8 min at threshold, 2 min recovery

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.text: how hard the session was, readable at a glance

reps.title: Repetitions
reps.text: the pace and heart rate of each one

weather.title: Weather
weather.text: temperature, wind and humidity during the session

adjusted.title: Adjusted pace
adjusted.text: plotted next to your pace, under the course profile

analysis.testing: Want to know your zones first?
analysis.captureAlt: Session analysis in the Enduraw dashboard: threshold 2 intervals detected automatically, 4 × 8 min, very hard intensity, weather, adjusted pace and each repetition with its pace and heart rate
analysis.caption: Session analysis in the Activities tab, sample data

offers.title: To go further
offers.lead: Two ways to be supported: an expert eye on your data, or a coach for the whole season.
offers.photoAlt: Triathlete on a time-trial bike during a race

data.title: Personal data follow-up
data.text: Your training and racing data read by the Enduraw team, to understand what they say about your form and your races. The format is set with you: tell us what you want to follow.
data.subject: Personal data follow-up

coaching.title: Enduraw coaching
coaching.text: A format built around your goals and your race calendar. We follow performance as a whole: training, nutrition, refuelling, sleep.

items.planning: Monthly planning tailored to your goals
items.advice: Scientific advice to optimise your training
items.feedback: Weekly feedback on your training data
items.support: Phone and email support, with replies within 48 h
items.pacing: A pacing strategy for your main races
items.call: One video call a month on a technical topic: training optimisation, race analysis

elite.title: Elite support, on request
elite.text: For high-level athletes: close, tailored support built with you around your season goals and major races. Places are limited.
elite.subject: Elite support

cta.title: Let's build your season together
cta.text: Tell us about your goals and race calendar, and we'll suggest the support that fits you best.
